title: Where Iris can point you
intro: Ask Iris a question out loud. When one of these fits, she highlights the card so you can open it yourself.

links.name: Phone check
links.summary: An iPhone and Android checklist on the Iris page. Tap what you see; the page classes the phone A / B / C and tells you what to remove yourself.
links.label: Open phone check

links.name: Chain read
links.summary: Paste a public Solana signature, Bitcoin txid or Ethereum hash and the page names what was actually signed, such as unlimited approvals or SetAuthority.
links.label: Open chain read

links.name: Iris page
links.summary: The full Iris page: runs in your own browser, works offline once loaded, and is available in six languages.
links.label: Open Iris

links.name: Human support
links.summary: Write to the elghaly desk by email. Never include seed phrases, private keys or passwords.
links.label: Email support
